rationale: Run hit the Moncler homepage, which has no PLP grid. Likely causes: region/cookie gates and lack of direct PLP navigation. We prioritize non-code fixes: start directly on a stable PLP (men/outerwear), set Accept-Language to en-GB, and auto-accept cookies/close locale modal. We also add robust discovery by treating anchors with '/en-gb/.../p/' as product links if no explicit tiles render. URL normalization forces the en-gb locale and avoids locale traps or monclergroup.com redirects.
code_hints: - Before waiting for PLP items, attempt to click cookie consent if present: query '#onetrust-accept-btn-handler' or a button with aria-label containing 'Accept all' (case-insensitive).
- If a locale/country modal is detected (role=dialog), first try clicking a link to '/en-gb/' or otherwise close via a button with aria-label containing 'Close'.
- If landing on a non-PLP page (homepage), navigate directly to the category by pushing the normalized URL 'https://www.moncler.com/en-gb/men/outerwear/'.
- Fallback PLP detection: if configured PLP tiles are not found after scroll, collect anchors matching regex '/en-gb/.+/p/' within <main> and treat them as product tiles.
- PDP price fallback: parse JSON-LD script[type='application/ld+json'] for a Product object and read offers.price if CSS price selectors are empty.
- Enforce locale normalization: when encountering '/en-xx/' or missing locale, rewrite to '/en-gb/' before requesting.
- Only follow links on allowed hosts and reject any navigation to monclergroup.com subdomains.
